title: MendingEnchant
description: Make possible to have mending with enchant table
body:
##

Lightweight Mending enchantment management

MendingEnchant lets players get Mending from the enchanting table without making the game feel unbalanced. It allows Mending to appear directly on tools, weapons, armor, and books.

By default, the chance to get Mending scales with the enchantment level cost:

  • Level cost 30: 6% chance
  • Level cost 20: 4% chance
  • Level cost 10: 2% chance
  • Level cost 5: 1% chance

These are the default values and can be changed in the configuration to better fit your server balance.

Features

  • Get Mending from the enchanting table
  • Enchant books with Mending
  • Enchant tools, weapons, and armor with Mending
  • Editable enchanting chances in the config file
  • Permission management
  • Multiple custom probabilities based on permission nodes
  • Configurable chance to obtain Mending while fishing
  • Item filters and world filters
  • Pity system for enchanting, increasing the chance after repeated failed attempts
  • Admin commands for reload and info
  • Localization support
  • Auto-update support
  • Works on Minecraft 1.13+

Since version 1.6.0, MendingEnchant uses bStats to collect anonymous usage data for plugin statistics.

Permission Description Default
mendingenchant.use Allows players to obtain Mending from the enchanting table. Yes
mendingenchant.custom1 Applies the custom probability 1 value when enchanting. No
mendingenchant.custom2 Applies the custom probability 2 value when enchanting. No
mendingenchant.custom3 Applies the custom probability 3 value when enchanting. No
mendingenchant.admin.reload Allows reloading the plugin configuration with the admin command. OP
mendingenchant.admin.info Allows viewing the plugin configuration summary with the admin command. OP
mendingenchant.bypass.itemfilter Bypasses the configured item filter. No
mendingenchant.bypass.worldfilter Bypasses the configured world filter. No

Just drag and drop MendingEnchant.jar into your plugins folder.

If you find any issue, please report it on GitHub or on Discord.
